Post 1
📉 ASX 200 hit a 20-day low Thursday, shedding 92pts or 1.03% to 8,819.40. Down 2.23% over five days, the index is running out of runway fast. Year-to-date gain now a thin 1.21%. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
Every sector closed red. IT led the damage at -1.74%, Materials followed at -1.63%. Telcos held up best at -0.13%. No hiding place today — breadth was as bad as the headline. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
🔻 Austal dropped 6.01% to AUD4.38, the sharpest fall among industrials. Defence names aren't immune when risk appetite drains across the board. #ASX #industrials #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD6,176.03/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7217. A firm local gold price offered little shelter — gold miners WGX and WAF moved in opposite directions, down 5.66% and up 2.91%. #gold #mining #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 2.23% lower over five days at 8,819.40. The line in the sand: does IT stabilise after today's -1.74% hit? Watch US tech overnight. Bull or bear from here — what's your call? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
